description: Asian Disaster Preparedness Center (ADPC) is a data repository run by Asian Disaster Preparedness Center. The regional centre publishes disaster risk reduction reports, country risk profiles and tools, and hosts regional hazard and early-warning information for South and South-East Asia. Coverage: South and South-East Asia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as pdf, html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account.
